item.title: Brothers of Renee Good, woman killed by immigration officer, call for action in Congress
item.description: The brothers of Renee Good, a U.S. citizen killed by an immigration officer in Minneapolis, are urging Congress to take action.

item.title: No. 22 St. John's overcomes shaky start to beat DePaul 68-56 for its 8th straight win
item.description: Zuby Ejiofor had 16 points and nine rebounds as No. 22 St. John's beat DePaul 68-56 for its eighth straight victory.

item.title: Asian shares are mixed and gold and silver climb higher after a retreat on Wall St
item.description: Shares are mixed in Asia, with markets in Japan and China dragged lower by selling of tech-related stocks.

item.title: Sam Lewis, Thijs De Ridder lead No. 18 Virginia to 67-47 win over Pitt
item.description: Sam Lewis scored 15 points, Thijs De Ridder had 10 points and 12 rebounds and No. 18 Virginia beat Pittsburgh 67-47 while scoring its fewest points this season.

item.title: Hong Kong firm begins arbitration proceedings over ruling against its Panama Canal port contract
item.description: Hong Kong's CK Hutchison Holdings says its subsidiary started arbitration proceedings against Panama after that country's Supreme Court ruled a concession for the subsidiary to operate Panama Canal ports was unconstitutional.

item.title: Maccelli scores 2 as Maple Leafs beat Oilers 5-2, head into Olympic break with 3 straight wins
item.description: Matias Maccelli scored twice and the Toronto Maple Leafs defeated the Edmonton Oilers 5-2 on Tuesday night.

item.title: Jalen Hurts leads NFC past AFC in high-scoring Pro Bowl Games flag football exhibition
item.description: Jalen Hurts threw three touchdown passes in flag football as the NFC beat the AFC 66-52 in the Pro Bowl Games.

item.title: Dunlap's career-high 22 points help No. 19 Saint Louis top Davidson 91-82 for 16th straight win
item.description: Brady Dunlap went 6 of 6 from 3-point range and finished with a career-high 22 points as No. 19 Saint Louis came back to beat Davidson 91-82 for its 16th straight win.

item.title: Copeland sets the table with 16 assists to send NC State past SMU 84-83
item.description: Darrion Williams scored 25 points and Quadir Copeland posted a double-double and NC State stayed perfect on the road in ACC play by beating SMU 84-83.

item.title: Booker scores career-high 24 points, leads hot-shooting UCLA over Rutgers 98-66
item.description: Xavier Booker scores a career-high 24 points as UCLA routs Rutgers 98-66 on Tuesday night.
